how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-dustwallow-marsh-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1135:obj:0: Bring 10 Highperch Venom Sacs to Fiora Longears in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1135:details:0: As you may know, wyverns are often tamed by orcs for use as mounts. But what is less known is that the venom of a wyvern, in some circles, is more valuable than the beast itself. So if you're not afraid to do a little wyvern hunting, then... I have a job for you.
rows.quest:1135:details:1: BThere is a place called Highperch in the land of a ⟦E2⟧, west of here. The Highperch wyverns have a potent venom. Potent, and valuable.
rows.quest:1135:completion:0: Ah, most of these are nearly bursting with venom, ⟦1⟧. Such are normally only gathered from young wyverns, or fertile females. It must have been quite a slaughter up there in Highperch!
rows.quest:1166:obj:0: Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village wants you to retrieve his grog, snuff and strongbox in Dustwallow Swamp.
rows.quest:1166:details:1: BRexxar make me mighty leader of Stonemaul Clan!
rows.quest:1166:details:2: BMe good leader. Me keep clan safe.
rows.quest:1166:details:3: BBig dragons come and make fire at old home. Me smart ogre. Find new home for clan here.
rows.quest:1166:details:4: BLeave old home so fast, me forget stuff. Tiny ⟦2⟧, go get my things. Go south and find my yummy grog, my snuff and my strongbox. Me like you after you do that. You look in Den of Flame and Stonemaul Ruins... they be there, me sure!
rows.quest:1166:completion:0: You good ⟦3⟧. Me miss things very much. Me like you now.
rows.quest:1168:obj:0: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
rows.quest:1168:details:0: Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.
rows.quest:1168:details:1: BBlack dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.
rows.quest:1168:details:2: BOgre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.
rows.quest:1168:details:3: BMe call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.
rows.quest:1168:details:4: BHelp ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.
rows.quest:1168:completion:0: You kill many of the black dragon army. You brave ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:1169:obj:0: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village would like you to bring him 15 Searing Tongues and 15 Searing Hearts.
rows.quest:1169:details:0: Whilst that craven fool, Mok'Morokk, wallows in power and Tharg wrestles the demons of sorrow and vengeance and vies for leadership of the clan, I seem to be the only one concerned with identifying the source of aggression on our old home.
rows.quest:1169:details:1: BWhy the puzzled stare, ⟦5⟧? Expecting me to speak like an uncouth ruffian merely because I am an ogre?
rows.quest:1169:details:2: BNow back to business, bring to me the hearts and tongues from the whelps and hatchlings. I shall trace the root of this evil...
rows.quest:1169:completion:0: 'Twas a perilous affair, no doubt, collecting all of these hearts and tongues. I shall delve into the depths of the arcane to trace the origin of the black menace which has descended upon our former home.
rows.quest:1170:obj:0: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1170:details:0: Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of ⟦E4⟧. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, ⟦E5⟧, descend upon our lands?
rows.quest:1170:details:1: BThis is most troubling. Surely, ⟦E4⟧ was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.
rows.quest:1170:details:2: BNotify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.
rows.quest:1170:completion:0: Why you tell me 'bout dragons? Me no like dragons. Me like it here. No dragons here.
rows.quest:1171:obj:0: Speak with Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1171:details:0: You leave me alone now. Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. No black dragon here.
rows.quest:1171:completion:1: BMok'Morokk displayed strength when Rexxar was our leader. But soon after Rexxar's departure Mok'Morokk fell prey to temptations of power. Rather than lead, he demanded. He does not serve his people but rather expects us to serve him.
rows.quest:1172:obj:0: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1172:details:0: ⟦E4⟧'s brood has been scattered across the Dragonmurk. It is imperative that no more whelps be permitted to hatch.
rows.quest:1172:details:1: BMake haste to Wyrmbog in the south of ⟦E6⟧. Surely, she has made her lair there. Track down the evil dragon's eggs and destroy them.
rows.quest:1172:details:2: BWe will never reclaim Stonemaul Village if the surrounding area remains a breeding ground.
rows.quest:1172:details:3: BAs for Mok'Morokk... I have other plans for the sod.
rows.quest:1172:completion:0: Splendid! It will be sometime before ⟦E4⟧ can produce more eggs.
rows.quest:1172:completion:1: BOn behalf of my people, I thank you, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:1172:completion:2: BI have asked much of you so far. Perhaps you can do the Stonemaul Clan one last service.
rows.quest:1172:completion:3: BMok'Morokk is not fit to lead us. Tharg would make an excellent leader but is hindered by his injuries and age. Drive Mok'Morokk from this place by force. Only then can we appoint a new leader to return us to our proper home in the south.
rows.quest:1173:obj:0: Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1173:details:3: BYou tell me when ready for good beating.
rows.quest:1173:completion:0: That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. You have done a great service, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:1173:completion:1: BNow my people can appoint a new leader, one who will help us reclaim our old home once and for all.
rows.quest:1177:obj:0: Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow wants 8 Mirefin Heads.
rows.quest:1177:details:2: BGo bash fishy. Bring Mud food.
rows.quest:1177:details:3: BYou feed Mud or Mud eat you.
rows.quest:1201:obj:0: Kill 9 ⟦E1⟧ Infiltrators, then return to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1201:details:0: The ⟦E7⟧ and ⟦E8⟧ hold an uneasy truce. Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the ⟦E7⟧ is on top!
rows.quest:1201:details:1: BNow is the chance to do just that.
rows.quest:1201:details:2: BAlliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village. They spy on the village and report our movements to ⟦E1⟧, which we cannot allow.
rows.quest:1201:details:3: BHunt down the infiltrators and slay them. Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!
rows.quest:1201:completion:0: Good work. Their infiltrators are skilled, but they're not good enough to escape the watchful eye of the ⟦E7⟧!
rows.quest:1202:obj:0: Bring the Captain's Documents to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1202:details:0: ⟦9⟧, two of our spies were sent to steal documents from a ship at the ⟦E1⟧ docks. They gained the papers but were discovered, and were forced to throw the documents into the sea.
rows.quest:1202:details:1: BOne spy later escaped, but was unable to recover the prize. He reported his failure to me, and I now charge the task to you.
rows.quest:1202:details:2: BThe documents are in a footlocker, in the waters somewhere beneath the ⟦E1⟧ docks. Find those documents, ⟦10⟧, and bring them to me.
rows.quest:1202:completion:0: I commend you, ⟦11⟧. This was not an easy mission. But the documents you gained are valued greatly by our superiors.
rows.quest:1203:obj:0: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1203:details:0: I have cutting to do. I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade. A certain blade...
rows.quest:1203:details:1: BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword. I call it a swing blade.
rows.quest:1203:details:2: BYou help me? Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.
rows.quest:1203:details:3: BBut don't sleep on this. What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
rows.quest:1203:completion:0: That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! Now I want to try it....
rows.quest:1203:completion:1: BLater. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... thanks.
rows.quest:1204:obj:0: Bring 8 Forked Mudrock Tongues to Morgan Stern in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1204:details:0: I'm working on a dish I call "Mudrock Soup and Bugs." I still need the major ingredients, and... well, I don't think I'd last long trudging through ⟦E6⟧!
rows.quest:1204:details:1: BSo, ⟦12⟧, can you do some hunting for me? First, I need the tongues of Mudrock turtles. You can find Mudrocks along the coast, mostly around the bay.
rows.quest:1204:details:2: BBut I don't want just any tongues! I hear that the tongues of some Mudrocks are forked...
rows.quest:1204:details:3: BThey say the forked tongues have a distinct flavor, and I want that flavor in my dish...
rows.quest:1204:completion:0: These will do fine! Thank you, ⟦13⟧!
rows.quest:1204:completion:1: BNow I'll try different cooking techniques on these tongues to find the best way to bring out their flavor.
rows.quest:1204:completion:2: BEventually I'll have a dish worthy of serving at the Blue Recluse in ⟦E9⟧!
rows.quest:1205:obj:0: Bring Deadmire's Tooth to Melor in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1205:details:0: Deadmire is an ancient crocolisk in Dustwallow marsh. And it is his time to die.
rows.quest:1205:details:1: BOld bones grind as he pulls his huge body through the swamp, and although he still moves with the strength and speed of youth, his aging body tortures the great spirit within it, a spirit whose flame will not waver.
rows.quest:1205:details:2: BYet now he lives in constant, maddening pain. You must end the life of this noble creature, ⟦14⟧. You must lead Deadmire to peace.
rows.quest:1205:completion:1: BI am sure the hunt was not easy, but it is good to know the beast's pain has finally ended.
rows.quest:1206:obj:0: Bring 20 Unpopped Darkmist Eyes to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at the Swamplight Manor.
rows.quest:1206:details:0: Eye juice is good juice for drinking. Too bad most critters only have two eyes.
rows.quest:1206:details:1: BBut spiders have lots of eyes. Lots and lots. And Darkmist eye juice is tasty. Smooth and salty! Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.
rows.quest:1206:details:2: BDarkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern. You figure the spiders are named after the cave... or is it the other way around?
rows.quest:1206:completion:0: You got the eyes! You got the eyes! Tasty, tasty spider eyes!
rows.quest:1206:completion:1: BSome eyes... when you stare at them they stare back. Eat those last. They keep you company... out in the swamp.
rows.quest:1206:completion:2: BHello, little spider eyes. Hello! You taste like chicken. Gooey, salty chicken!
rows.quest:1218:obj:0: Bring 3 Soothing Spices to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1218:details:0: I like cooking. Good swamp cooking. Fried green frog legs and the like.
rows.quest:1218:details:1: BAnd for cooking, I need spice. Soothing spice. Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.
rows.quest:1218:completion:0: Ah, that's the spice! Now here's some swampy good stew.
rows.quest:1219:obj:0: Bring the Spy's Report to a ⟦E1⟧ Lieutenant.
rows.quest:1219:details:0: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
rows.quest:1219:details:1: BThe parchment is written in orcish... and it looks important.
rows.quest:1219:completion:0: Hm... I can't read orcish very well, but this looks like a report... written by an orc spy!
rows.quest:1220:obj:0: Bring the Spy's Report to Captain Garran Vimes.
rows.quest:1220:details:0: Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, ⟦16⟧. He knows the orcish language better than most. And he should know that there are ⟦E7⟧ spies near ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:1220:details:1: BThe captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of ⟦E1⟧ Isle.
rows.quest:1220:completion:0: A report from an orc spy! How did you find this? No matter -- let's see what it says...
rows.quest:1222:obj:0: Escort "Stinky" Ignatz, then speak with Morgan Stern in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1222:details:0: Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!
rows.quest:1222:details:1: BI need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:1222:details:2: BThe cook Morgan Stern is researching a new recipe, and he sent me out here to gather bogbean leaves. I guess he thinks they're tasty.
rows.quest:1222:details:3: BAnyway, while looking for a bogbean plant... I got myself surrounded! Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for the bogbean?
rows.quest:1222:completion:0: Mr. Ignatz was just here with the bogbean leaves, and he told me you helped him out of some real trouble.
rows.quest:1222:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦18⟧. I will ask my uncle to treat you to a feast the next time you visit the Blue Recluse in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1238:obj:0: Bring the Spy's Report to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1238:details:0: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
rows.quest:1238:details:1: BThe parchment is a report made by an orc who spent weeks spying on the city of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1238:details:2: BAfter scanning the parchment, it is clear that it must be brought to the orc spymaster in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1238:completion:0: Good work, ⟦19⟧. Our agent, Marg Nighteye, was stationed outside ⟦E1⟧. He was charged to spy on the city.
rows.quest:1238:completion:1: BThis is his latest report, and it may be his last -- from your testimony, I fear that Marg met his end in the swamp...
rows.quest:1239:obj:0: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1239:details:0: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck. His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
rows.quest:1239:completion:0: This is the head of Marg Nighteye! As I feared, he is dead.
rows.quest:1239:completion:1: BLook at the wound on his neck! Could a weapon have made that ragged cut, or did some beast slay our agent?
rows.quest:1239:completion:2: BThis is a mystery we must solve, ⟦20⟧. We must discover if Marg's death was at the hands of the ⟦E8⟧!
rows.quest:1240:obj:0: Take the Defiant Orc Head to Kin'weelay in the Grom'gol Base Camp in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1240:details:0: We must know the events surrounding Marg's death! And the only way to do that, ⟦21⟧, is through the witch-magic of trolls.
rows.quest:1240:details:1: BBring Marg's head to Kin'weelay in ⟦E11⟧, at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:1240:details:2: BKin'weelay is the most powerful witchdoctor of the ⟦E12⟧ trolls. If anyone can speak to Marg Nighteye's spirit, it is he.
rows.quest:1240:completion:0: Ah, I now see. The spirit of this orc is bound in our world, boiling with rage from a task yet undone.
rows.quest:1240:completion:1: BWell, let us have words with this angry orc...
rows.quest:1251:obj:0: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1251:details:0: An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.
rows.quest:1251:details:1: BThe shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.
rows.quest:1251:completion:0: I grant that humans have strange decorating tastes, but would they use a plain iron shield to adorn their fireplace? Perhaps this shield was placed there by the ones who burned the inn.
rows.quest:1252:obj:0: Bring Reethe's Badge to Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1252:details:0: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1252:details:1: BUnderneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
rows.quest:1252:completion:0: It's never good news when a guard's badge is brought to me.
rows.quest:1252:completion:1: BSometimes it's a man or woman who's fallen in battle, and I'm left to bring the news to the grieving family. Other times we never find out what happened to them. And other times it's even worse than that.
rows.quest:1253:obj:0: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1253:details:0: An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.
rows.quest:1253:details:1: BThe shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.
rows.quest:1253:completion:0: Hm, I'm no expert with the construction of arms and armor. Their use, yes, but not their making.
rows.quest:1253:completion:1: BThis shield seems as ordinary as any, excepting the damage from the fire that engulfed the inn.
rows.quest:1258:obj:0: Bring 12 Pristine Crawler Legs to Morgan Stern in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1258:details:0: Another component of my new recipe is the shelled leg of a giant crab. And the crabs they have in Dustwallow -- Muckshells they call them -- just won't do! I'm afraid the only suitable crabs live far away, in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1258:details:1: BThe shell of the crab leg is a key element of the dish's presentation so I need pristine, unscarred legs. An adult crab might only have one or two such legs, and I need a lot in order to research my dish.
rows.quest:1258:details:2: BSo, ⟦22⟧... are you willing to travel?
rows.quest:1258:completion:0: These are wonderful specimens, ⟦23⟧! The shells are in perfect condition, and the meat is pink and tender. The blood of a chef is in your veins, I'm sure of it!
rows.quest:1259:obj:0: Find out more about Reethe from Adjutant Tesoran in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1259:details:0: I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the ⟦E1⟧ guard, from personnel to their equipment.
rows.quest:1259:details:1: BHe should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
rows.quest:1259:completion:0: Hello, ⟦24⟧. You'd like information about a specific member of the ⟦E1⟧ guard? Reethe, was it?
rows.quest:1259:completion:1: BJust give me a moment to find the right book.
rows.quest:1260:details:0: I'm developing a new menu for the restaurant. It will be filled with rural dishes with a "bayou" theme. I think my clientele at the Blue Recluse will love them!
rows.quest:1260:details:1: BI sent my nephew Morgan to ⟦E1⟧, a city on the edge of the ⟦E6⟧. He's there gathering recipes from the locals, and I must know what he found so far.
rows.quest:1260:details:2: BThe trip to ⟦E1⟧ is long. Too long for me. But I bet a young ⟦25⟧ like yourself would jump at the chance to travel, yes?
rows.quest:1260:completion:0: Oh, my uncle sent you, did he?
rows.quest:1260:completion:1: BWell I've been researching recipes and I have some leads, but I need help.
rows.quest:1260:completion:2: BHelp from someone willing to get his feet wet.
rows.quest:1261:obj:0: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1261:details:0: Cursed muckshell! You can't kill Marg! Ah, but I am dead. So it must have slain me...
rows.quest:1261:details:1: BBut my mission! My mission! You, ⟦26⟧, must complete it.
rows.quest:1261:details:2: BWhile near ⟦E1⟧, I spied a group of ⟦E8⟧ soldiers camped on the beach. And one soldier wore a pendant... a pendant laden with more gems than any soldier could afford!
rows.quest:1261:details:3: BThat night I snuck into their camp and stole the pendant, but on my return to base a muckshell crab-man killed me!
rows.quest:1261:details:4: B⟦27⟧, you must find that muckshell and recover the pendant!
rows.quest:1261:completion:0: This pendant was worn by a soldier of ⟦E9⟧??
rows.quest:1261:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦28⟧. You have revealed the secret of Marg's death. But this pendant is a new mystery to solve, one that may have dire effects on the ⟦E8⟧, and the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1262:obj:0: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:1262:details:0: It is strange that the pendant Marg stole was in the hands of common soldiers. Perhaps its owner was in disguise, or perhaps the soldiers themselves stole it!
rows.quest:1262:details:1: BRegardless of which is true, this is a noble's pendant and we must discover its true owner if we are to unravel its mystery.
rows.quest:1262:details:2: BTake the pendant to Zor Lonetree in ⟦E14⟧. He is well schooled in ⟦E8⟧ politics, and will know if this pendant has a history among the nobles of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1262:completion:0: This pendant was crafted with great skill and precision, ⟦29⟧. No orc would covet such a jewel...
rows.quest:1262:completion:2: BI will have this pendant studied. In time let us hope that its mysteries will be revealed to us.
rows.quest:1268:obj:0: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1268:details:0: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
rows.quest:1268:completion:0: Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. Or maybe even the centaur. Their presence in the ⟦E15⟧ is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act.
rows.quest:1268:completion:1: BDid I tell you? It wasn't just that the inn was burned down... The owner's woman and pup were killed. Bad business, that.
rows.quest:1268:completion:2: BNonetheless, I will send Kagoro to find where the tracks lead.
rows.quest:1269:obj:0: Bring Reethe's Badge to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1269:details:0: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1269:details:1: BUnderneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
rows.quest:1269:completion:0: I know this human, Paval Reethe. Pathetic, even for his kind. He deserted his fellow soldiers and is now hiding out in the woods.
rows.quest:1269:completion:1: BI sent Ogron out to track him down. Some of the others suspect he's been stealing from our supplies. I think I saw Ogron heading off to the southeast.
rows.quest:1270:obj:0: Escort "Stinky" Ignatz, then speak with Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1270:details:0: Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!!
rows.quest:1270:details:1: BI need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:1270:details:2: BA goblin from Ratchet named Mebok Mizzyrix needs some bogbean leaves for a potion, or something... I honestly don't care why -- his money was good and I know this swamp, so here I am.
rows.quest:1270:details:3: BToo bad I got myself surrounded before I found the bogbean! Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for Mebok's plant?
rows.quest:1270:completion:0: Stinky was here with the herbs I ask of him, and he told me you helped him out of a bind. Good work! A friend of Stinky's is a friend of mine!
rows.quest:1270:completion:1: BHe asked me to give you this if I ever saw you, right before he walked back south toward the marsh.
rows.quest:1271:completion:0: My nephew said you aided him with his research in Dustwallow, and that you helped his associate out of a tight spot. Well, we Sterns stick together and we don't ignore our friends!
rows.quest:1271:completion:1: BSo wash your hands, ⟦31⟧, because we're about to throw a party in your honor!
rows.quest:1273:obj:0: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1273:details:0: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.
rows.quest:1273:details:1: BOgron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.
rows.quest:1273:completion:0: Hmph. It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound.
rows.quest:1273:completion:1: BIt seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.
rows.quest:1276:obj:0: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Mosarn in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1276:details:0: Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in ⟦E10⟧. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before.
rows.quest:1276:details:1: BIn thanks, the ⟦E16⟧ awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. Very good work.
rows.quest:1276:details:2: BPerhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted.
rows.quest:1276:details:3: BIt's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.
rows.quest:1276:completion:0: Yes, you are certainly correct. This is a shield that I made.
rows.quest:1276:completion:1: BI'm afraid there's not much more I can tell you though, ⟦32⟧. I craft so many different shields and sets of armor, I can't keep track of them all.
rows.quest:1282:obj:0: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes on the top floor of Foothold Citadel.
rows.quest:1282:details:0: I can't help it if I feel sorry for ol' Jim there. He wasn't always like that. Ran an inn out in the marsh for a while, wonderful place.
rows.quest:1282:details:1: BLook, I don't really want to talk about it. Bring it up with Captain Vimes if you really have to. He's stationed on the top floor of Foothold Citadel, the large barracks to the east of Lady Jaina's tower.
rows.quest:1282:completion:0: James Hyal's his real name. He opened an inn at the edge of the ⟦E15⟧. Wanted to make a nice place for travelers to stop over...
rows.quest:1282:completion:1: BMight be he was thinking too big, but the inn did do well for a while. Then we lost control of the roads in the marsh, and the ogres took over.
rows.quest:1282:completion:2: BJames was too stubborn to give up his dream for safety within our walls, and the Shady Rest Inn was burnt to the ground. We're investigating, but haven't had much luck. If you want to help out, see what you can find in the rubble.
rows.quest:1284:obj:0: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1284:details:0: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
rows.quest:1284:completion:0: Hoofprints, eh? It is true that there is an extraordinary amount of centaur activity in the lands near the ⟦E6⟧. In brief excursions into the ⟦E15⟧, we found their camps and holdings dotting the area.
rows.quest:1284:completion:1: BI'll send out Falgran Hastil, one of our trackers, to see if he can find where the tracks lead.
rows.quest:1285:obj:0: Return the information about Reethe to Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1285:details:0: Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! Lieutenant Paval Reethe.
rows.quest:1285:details:1: BJoined the ⟦E1⟧ guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...
rows.quest:1285:completion:0: Missing? That would be Tesoran's kind way of saying traitor.
rows.quest:1285:completion:1: BNo doubt he's one of those fools so blindly loyal to Admiral Daelin that he turned traitor. Isn't that a delicious irony? The deserters accuse us of betraying the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1286:obj:0: Get information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1286:details:0: It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.
rows.quest:1286:details:1: BThe latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.
rows.quest:1286:details:2: BThe local lieutenant seems to be Balos Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.
rows.quest:1286:details:3: BBe warned, ⟦33⟧. He may be a tough nut to crack.
rows.quest:1286:completion:0: Did Vimes send you? Couldn't do his dirty work himself, could he...
